Caleb Nguyen: Quick follow-up from today's PM: repeated fallback-to-backend incidents when our cache tier warms. Need clear owners, tickets, RACI, and short timelines.
Rina Patel: I'll own immediate mitigation (circuit-breaker + soft-fallback). Will open a Jira and aim for 6bd.
Diego Morales: I'll do instrumentation + dashboard tiles to track post-scale hit-rate.
Hannah Lee: I'll handle rollout gating + acceptance criteria; define rollback thresholds.
Caleb Nguyen: Good. Make two tickets: one hotfix (Rina) and one design spike (Diego). Label with pm-followup and recurring-incident.
Rina Patel: Created INF-9345: cache-fallback soft-circuit (hotfix). Target 6bd.
ops-bot: New Jira created by Rina: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9345 (INF-9345)
Diego Morales: Created INF-9346: cache-warmup-design. Includes priming strategy and perf test plan. Target 3w.
ops-bot: New Jira created by Diego: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9346 (INF-9346)
Hannah Lee: RACI: R: Rina (hotfix) / Diego (design), A: Caleb (PM), C: Hannah (rollout) + Eng-oncall, I: Support + Customer-success.
Diego Morales: I'll add metric "post-scale KV hit-rate" and an alert if it falls >40% for 2m.
Rina Patel: Hotfix plan (short): 1) add soft-circuit to prefer cached response when queueing high 2) backpressure knob 3) unit + smoke tests + canary.
Caleb Nguyen: Checkpoints: 72h update, demo after 5bd, full sign-off after 3w. Handoff rule: if owner offline >4bd, pass to oncall rotation.
Hannah Lee: Assigned tickets and set due dates. I'll schedule canary once Rina posts a build.
Diego Morales: Linking both tickets in the recurring-incident tracker and adding a short note about autoscale correlation.
Rina Patel: Pasted a small log sample to INF-9345 and set assignee.
Caleb Nguyen: Thanks — keep updates in this thread and tag me @Caleb if blocked. We'll escalate to a sprint if pattern doesn't improve after rollouts. :white_check_mark:
